title: Collateral Protection Insurance — Vehicle-Value Allowance on the Collision Deductible in Faxed Proof Re-Reviews
content:
When a faxed proof is re-reviewed under Collateral Protection Insurance on a closed tracking record, the ceiling for the proof's collision deductible is raised by a vehicle-value allowance set by the vehicle book value on the borrower's Retail Installment Contracts record (the wholesale book value used for loan-to-value at origination).

## Allowance by book value

- **Book value no more than USD 12500.00:** the collision ceiling is raised by USD 500.00.
- **Book value above USD 12500.00 and no more than USD 18000.00:** the collision ceiling is raised by USD 250.00.
- **Book value above USD 18000.00:** an allowance of USD 0.00.

## Both sides of each threshold

| Book value on the contract (USD) | Raise to the collision ceiling |
|---|---|
| 12500.00 | USD 500.00 |
| 12500.01 | USD 250.00 |
| 18000.00 | USD 250.00 |
| 18000.01 | USD 0.00 |

The book value read is the one on the contract record, not the valuation that places a tracking record in a CollateralGuard plan band. The allowance concerns the collision deductible only.

**Hypothetical:** with a hypothetical plan ceiling of USD 800.00 and a book value of USD 15000.00, the collision deductible ceiling is raised by USD 250.00, from USD 800.00 to USD 1050.00.
